title: Dart Basics
description: Test your knowledge of Dart fundamentals.

questions.text: Which keyword declares an immutable variable in Dart?
questions.explanation: 'final' declares a variable that can only be set once.

questions.text: What is the entry point function in a Dart program?
questions.explanation: Execution begins in the top-level main() function.

questions.text: Which operator is used for null-aware access?
questions.explanation: ?. safely accesses a member only if the target is non-null.

title: Flutter Widgets
description: How well do you know the widget tree?

questions.text: Which widget is immutable and described by its build method?
questions.explanation: StatelessWidget describes its UI purely from its configuration.

questions.text: What method rebuilds the widget tree in a StatefulWidget?
questions.explanation: Calling setState() marks the State dirty and schedules a rebuild.

questions.text: Which layout widget arranges children vertically?
questions.explanation: Column lays out its children along the vertical main axis.

questions.text: Which widget is used to add padding around another widget?
questions.explanation: Padding insets its child by the given EdgeInsets.

title: General Science
description: A mix of physics, chemistry, and biology questions.

questions.text: What is the chemical symbol for gold?
Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
questions.explanation: Iron oxide on the surface gives Mars its reddish color.

questions.text: What gas do plants absorb from the atmosphere for photosynthesis?
questions.explanation: Plants use CO2 and water to produce glucose and oxygen.

questions.text: How many bones are in the adult human body?
questions.explanation: The adult human skeleton has 206 bones.

questions.text: What is the speed of light in a vacuum (approx)?
questions.explanation: Light travels at about 299,792 km/s in vacuum.
